Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Ajay - 40 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Vihaan stands in the bathroom. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Anjali: "What happened?"

[Vihaan takes a quick bath.]

Vihaan: "That was such a fun day!"
